source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4 should get pass result.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; aggregate SDR/sensor reads neither identify four DIMM zones nor exercise thresholds, inspect SEL/memory response or acknowledge data-integrity risk.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; correctly adds zone mapping, ECC and recovery controls but incorrectly treats supplyable Project topology and thermal parameters as permanent blockage.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 768/2291 repeats YES/static reads; duplicate-code entry 1490/2291 is the separate PCIe Card Information case.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting REQUIRES classification was inspected only as history and independently confirmed with explicit memory-health gates.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 preserves per-zone dynamic coverage, ED-36 makes platform topology/limits normal readiness inputs, and ED-38 keeps actual DUT verdict ownership with engineers.

original_test_intent: Exercise every installed DIMM thermal zone represented by ZONE1 through ZONE4 across warning and critical limits, verify each zone's SDR and SEL behavior plus memory/fan/protection response, and prove cooldown, deassertion and memory-health recovery per zone.
original_method: An attended engineer heats, chambers or loads memory regions while ipmitool observes temperature channels; the source requires all zones to pass but does not map zone labels to DIMM slots/channels or define a safe stimulus.
manual_activity: An engineer maps the DIMM zones, protects active data/workloads, approves and applies the memory workload or thermal fixture, and owns emergency recovery. Automation can then collect a separate sensor/event/memory-health result for every zone.
required_inputs: installed memory topology and authoritative ZONE1~4 mapping to channels, slots, DIMMs and stable SDR identities
per-zone units, SDR types, accuracy, warning/critical values, tolerances and hysteresis
approved method to affect each zone independently or a documented thermal-coupling matrix
ramp/load, dwell, maximum temperature/power/time, abort and cooldown per zone
expected SEL event identity/severity/assert/deassert plus throttling/fan/shutdown behavior
ECC/EDAC baseline, allowed error policy, active-data/workload protection and post-test memory-health procedure
independent probe/telemetry, SEL retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not infer four physical zones from the range label; verify all installed/required channels and report missing, extra or shared-zone topology.
Do not heat/load DIMMs, alter thresholds or force sensor values while production data, active jobs or unprotected memory state may be affected.

Continuously monitor per-zone temperature, corrected/uncorrected ECC, EDAC, memory throttling, fans, power, console, BMC and host; abort on overshoot, ECC escalation, data error, instability or telemetry loss.
Export/hash existing SEL and relevant OS error logs; do not automatically clear them, auto-retry, or let one zone's transition satisfy the other zones.
Use approved authenticated access rather than DeepSeek's command-line password and disabled host verification.
After stimulus, cool every affected region, verify all deassertions, run the approved memory-health check and preserve the first anomaly before any further action.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer confirmation, enumerate the approved zone matrix and poll each exact SDR with DIMM/channel inventory, ECC/EDAC, memory workload, fans, power, SEL and console state.
Build a per-zone timeline covering baseline, warning, critical, protection response, cooldown and deassertion; identify cross-zone coupling instead of attributing a shared event to every zone.
Check the evidence matrix for every required zone and retain raw mismatch/error records without retry.
Do not create the memory workload/heat, select DIMM targets, change thresholds, clear evidence, reboot autonomously or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the physical zone-to-memory map, thermal/event/protection specification, data-protection plan and complete stimulus envelope.
Validate and operate the workload, chamber or local fixture with abort/recovery authority.
Assess coupling, ECC significance and final recovery, then issue a per-zone DUT verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR and sensor lists are baseline inputs only; they do not map zones to memory, generate transitions, read SEL or ECC, prove protection or establish all-zone coverage. The SSH pattern is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted bounded per-zone IPMI/SEL collection synchronized with memory topology, workload and ECC/EDAC telemetry plus calibrated independent probes under engineer-controlled stimulus.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The original commands, ZONE1~4 scope, heating requirement, script and 5/10-minute values are preserved; actual duration is set by the approved thermal plan.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT DIMM ZONE MATRIX AND THERMAL PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map every required zone to memory hardware, baseline temperature and ECC health, stimulate one bounded region at a time where feasible, correlate thresholds/events/protection, then cool and verify every zone plus memory integrity.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact DIMM/channel population, airflow topology, board sensors and BMC SDR package.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/DIMM population, BIOS/BMC/SDR, OS EDAC/RAS stack, workload/fixture and probe calibration.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform DIMM thermal limits and topology, sensor/SEL mapping, memory RAS/protection behavior and recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative zone topology, data/ECC safeguards, per-zone isolation and an all-zones completeness matrix.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Aggregate sensor output or one heated zone cannot prove all four zones; read-only evidence remains partial until physical transitions occur.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Zone topology, limits/event mapping, safe stimulus, memory-health policy and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: DIMM thermal stress may create corrected or uncorrected errors, data corruption, throttling or shutdown; airflow coupling can trigger multiple sensors from one stimulus.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define fewer installed zones or use a qualified workload/chamber instead of local heat, but must record each required/absent zone, actual method, equivalence limits and uncovered physical paths. No single-zone PASS may be generalized to ZONE1~4.
expected_evidence: SUT/board/memory inventory and authoritative zone-to-channel/slot/DIMM/SDR matrix
per-zone threshold/hysteresis/event/protection expectations and approved data-safe stimulus plan
fixture/probe calibration and timestamped per-zone temperature/workload timeline
per-zone SDR output and decoded SEL warning/critical assert/deassert entries
ECC/EDAC, memory throttle, fan, power and host/console behavior correlated to the triggering zone
baseline log export/hash and active-data/workload protection record
per-zone cooldown/deassertion, post-test memory-health result, restored host/BMC state, completeness matrix and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Code Wistron-BMC-00059-V003 is reused at row 1491 for unrelated PCIe Card Information. Row 769 is preserved as the DIMM thermal-zone variant by physical identity; Project topology must resolve the range label rather than code reuse or adjacency.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is clear: validate every Project-defined DIMM thermal zone through controlled threshold transitions and recovery. Zone mapping, limits and fixture parameters are normal readiness inputs, not irreducible semantics. With engineer setup, per-zone collection and comparison are automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES/no-risk to conditional attended execution and rejects aggregate snapshots as dynamic/all-zone proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while retaining the full memory, thermal and recovery safety envelope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms its classification and strengthens data/workload protection, cross-zone coupling and ECC-first stop criteria.

review_improvement: Turns the range-like case into an auditable four-zone memory-topology matrix with explicit ECC/data-integrity protection and prevents one thermal event from satisfying every zone.
independent_technical_reasoning: DIMM zone names and limits are platform-specific but the intended operation is not ambiguous. The physical stimulus and data-risk decisions require an engineer; once those inputs exist, software can deterministically correlate every zone, SEL event and memory-health signal. The correct readiness boundary is therefore REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.
